tools.name: convert_document
tools.description:
Convert a document up to 8 MB to Markdown and return it directly.

Pass the file as base64 in `content_base64`, or as a download link in
`file`, and its name in `filename`. The extension decides the type: .pdf,
.docx, .pptx, .xlsx, .html, .htm or .txt. Returns `markdown` and `meta`
(`filename`, `len

tools.name: submit_conversion_job
tools.description:
Queue a document up to 25 MB and 200 pages for conversion with OCR and tables.

Pass the file as base64 in `content_base64`, or as a download link in
`file`, and its name in `filename` (.pdf, .docx, .pptx, .xlsx, .html,
.htm or .txt). Returns `job_id`, `status` and `result_url`. Call
`get_conversion

tools.name: get_conversion_job
tools.description:
Check a queued conversion job you submitted.

Returns `job_id` and `status` (`queued`, `running`, `succeeded` or
`failed`). A succeeded job includes the `markdown` when it is under
100 KB, otherwise a `result_url` to download it (also free). A failed job
